attachments.origin_landmark: posterior surface of the styloid process
attachments.insertion_landmark: body of the hyoid at the junction with the greater horn

actions: elevates and retracts the hyoid, lengthening the floor of the mouth

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Its tendon is perforated by the posterior belly of digastric, which it parallels -- both are second pharyngeal arch muscles and both take CN VII.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
